name: gnome-email
title: GNOME Email
description: Read email from mail-enabled GNOME Online Accounts
author: 7system7

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Inbox
commands.subtitle: GNOME Online Accounts
commands.description: Show email from all GNOME Online Accounts

preferences.name: readOnlyMode
preferences.title: Read-Only Mode
preferences.label: Prevent changes to messages
preferences.description: Opens mailboxes read-only and hides actions that change message state.

preferences.name: showImages
preferences.title: Show Images
preferences.label: Show and download images in message bodies
preferences.description: Displays embedded images and allows the detail view to load remote images. Disable this to improve privacy and prevent tracking pixels from loading.

preferences.name: showFavicons
preferences.title: Show Account Favicons
preferences.label: Download account-domain favicons from Google
preferences.description: Sends only the domain part of each account address to Google's S2 favicon service.

preferences.name: allowInsecureLoopbackTls
preferences.title: Allow Self-Signed Local IMAP TLS
preferences.label: Accept untrusted TLS certificates from loopback IMAP servers
preferences.description: Required by some local bridges such as Proton Mail Bridge. Never applies to remote servers.

preferences.name: messageDownloadLimitMb
preferences.title: Maximum Message Processing Size
preferences.description: Maximum message data to retain for rendering when opening a message. For IMAP, this also caps the raw MIME source download; Microsoft Graph responses are limited after download.
